summary.en: The next scene, ground and all, pushes the current one off the frame from one edge in one heavy ease-out.
summary.zh: 下一场连着底色从一条边整屏推进来，把当前这场顶出画面，快进慢停。

fits: Chapter breaks: the next section of the same document, a numbered step, a new topic with its own ground colour; used at every chapter from the same edge, it becomes the film's page-turn beat.
notFor: Entering a part of the current scene (use card-portal or viewport-push); fast cuts on every beat (the long stop takes most of the push).

intent.en: The new chapter shoves the old one out as one solid slab, so the viewer reads "a new world" with a physical clunk; repeated, the pushes become the film's chapter rhythm.
intent.zh: 新章像一整块板把旧章顶出画外，观众读到“换了一个世界”，还带一记落位的“哐”；连用时换章本身成了全片的节拍。

content.en: Wraps two full scenes, each on its own saturated ground colour; no text of its own (the chapter's title belongs to the incoming scene).
content.zh: 包住两整场，各自铺一块饱和底色；自身不带文字（章节标题属于推进来的那一场）。

fits.zh: 换章：同一份东西的下一节、编号的下一步、换底色的新话题；全片每章都从同一条边推，就成了翻页的节拍骨架。

notFor.zh: 进入当前画面的某一部分（用 card-portal 或 viewport-push）；每拍都切的快剪（长长的落停占掉大半时间）。

pairs.note: the incoming ground colour can carry the chapter tone
a chapter title once the push has landed

en: Keep one direction for the whole film; switching edges mid-film breaks the chapter rhythm.
Start the chapter's own animation only after the push has landed (≥ 95 %); two moving screens leave the eye no anchor.
Use saturated grounds; with pale grounds it reads as cards changing backgrounds, not chapters.
zh: 全片保持一个推入方向；中途换边，换章的节拍就散了。
章内动画等推入落定（≥ 95%）再开始；两屏同时在动，视线没有落点。
底色要饱和；底色太淡读成“卡片各自换背景”，不像换章。

upstream.name: 底推换章
upstream.summary: 底边上推换章——新场景连底色整屏从底边向上推入，把旧场景物理顶出画外，连推数章各配一种饱和底色，内容钉死在各自色底坐标系里随底色走
upstream.use: 多章节产品片的换章骨架（每章一个卖点一种底色）；需要"翻页节奏感"贯穿全片的段落切换
